Prop For That originally handwritten and published with love on CSS-Tricks. You should really get the newsletter as well.

entry.title: Designing With Uncertainty: How AI Supercharges Probabilistic Thinking
entry.summary: In a world where AI is informing more design choices, it’s easy to mistake predictions for certainties. This article introduces Probabilistic Design, a mindset that allows UX and product teams to accept uncertainty, decipher AI outputs with nuance, and make smart, adaptive decisions.
